prayerExcerpt.en-US: Saint Stephen of Hungary, who fostered her growth while a king on earth
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Um valoroso propagador do Evangelho, quando reinava na terra

meta.face: A man of about sixty with a SQUARE, heavy-boned face — a wide, low forehead, flat, broad cheekbones, a strong straight nose with a high bridge, deep-set grey eyes under heavy, straight brows, a wide mouth under a drooping moustache and a broad jaw; shoulder-length straight light-brown hair streaked with grey under the crown, a long, full, grey-streaked beard cut square at the bottom, and a grave, resolute gaze to one side.
meta.basis: The coronation mantle he and Gisela gave in 1031 shows him crowned with lance and orb; the Hungarian tradition that followed (the double cross, the Holy Crown, a mature bearded king) gives the rest. The square face and beard are chosen to keep him apart from Louis and Wenceslaus.
